name: jquery
one_liner: An old but still widely used JavaScript library that makes websites interactive.
buyer: No current buyer — it's legacy developer infrastructure maintained for backward compatibility, not a new business opportunity.
business_use_cases: A legacy-system maintainer uses it to keep an old website functioning without a costly rewrite.
An agency offers paid support/migration for companies still dependent on old jQuery codebases.
No new product can reasonably be built around jQuery itself today.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid legacy-jQuery-site maintenance or modernization services to companies stuck on old stacks.

steal_this: Nothing to build on jQuery itself — any opportunity here is maintenance services for companies still using it, not a new product.
